luot.en: Do you work or are you a student?

pa.cau: Do you work or are you a student?

pa.cau: I work as an accountant for a manufacturing company in Hanoi. I’ve been there for about three years now.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ wɜːk‿əz‿ən‿əˈkaʊntənt fə ə ˌmænjəˈfæktʃərɪŋ ˈkʌmpəni ɪn ˈhænɔɪ aɪ viː bɪn ðə fə əˈbaʊt θriː jɪəz naʊ/

luot.en: I’d say the people, mainly. My colleagues are supportive, which makes the heavy workload much easier to handle. I also like that the work is quite structured.

pa.cau: I’d say the people, mainly. My colleagues are supportive, which makes the heavy workload much easier to handle. I also like that the work is quite structured.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ diː seɪ ðə ˈpiːpəl ˈmeɪnliː maɪ ˈkɑːliːɡz‿ə səˈpɔːtɪv‿wɪtʃ meɪks ðə ˈheviː ˈwɜːkləʊd mʌtʃ ˈiːziːə tə ˈhændəl‿aɪ ˈɔːlsəʊ laɪk ðət ðə wɜːk‿ɪz kwaɪt ˈstrʌktʃəd/

luot.en: Is there anything you would change?

pa.cau: Is there anything you would change?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz ðə ˈeniːˌθɪŋ‿jə wəd tʃeɪndʒ/

luot.en: The deadline pressure, definitely. At the end of each quarter we often work overtime, and that has a real impact on my work-life balance.
luot.vi: Speaking Part 2 — dàn ý 4 bước cho mọi đề:

pa.cau: The deadline pressure, definitely. At the end of each quarter we often work overtime, and that has a real impact on my work-life balance.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðə ˈdedlaɪn ˈpreʃə ˈdefənətliː ət ðə end‿əv‿iːtʃ ˈkwɔːtə wiː ˈɔːfən‿wɜːk ˈəʊvətaɪm‿ən ðət həz‿ə riːl ˌɪˈmpækt‿ɑːn maɪ wɜːk laɪf ˈbæləns/

luot.en: What makes a job satisfying?
luot.vi: Điều gì khiến một công việc mang lại sự hài lòng?

pa.cau: What makes a job satisfying?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt meɪks‿ə dʒɒb ˈsætɪˌsfaɪɪŋ/

luot.en: For most people it is a combination of fair pay and a sense of progress. Personally, I value being trusted to make decisions more than the salary itself.
luot.vi: Với phần lớn mọi người đó là kết hợp giữa lương hợp lý và cảm giác tiến bộ. Cá nhân tôi coi trọng việc được tin tưởng ra quyết định hơn là bản thân mức lương.

pa.cau: For most people it is a combination of fair pay and a sense of progress. Personally, I value being trusted to make decisions more than the salary itself.
pa.ipa_noi: /fə məʊst ˈpiːpəl‿ɪt‿ɪz‿ə ˌkɑːmbəˈneɪʃən‿əv feə peɪ ən‿ə sens‿əv ˈprɑːˌɡres ˈpɜːsənəliː aɪ ˈvæljuː ˈbiːɪŋ ˈtrʌstɪd tə meɪk dɪˈsɪʒənz mɔː ðən ðə ˈsæləri ˌɪˈtself/

luot.en: Is it common in your country to change jobs frequently?
luot.vi: Ở nước bạn việc nhảy việc thường xuyên có phổ biến không?

pa.cau: Is it common in your country to change jobs frequently?
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪz‿ɪt ˈkɑːmən‿ɪn‿jə ˈkʌntri tə tʃeɪndʒ dʒɑːbz ˈfriːkwəntliː/

luot.en: It has become much more common among younger workers. Older generations tended to stay with one employer, largely because job security was valued more highly.
luot.vi: Điều đó đã trở nên phổ biến hơn nhiều ở người trẻ. Thế hệ trước thường gắn bó một nơi, chủ yếu vì họ coi trọng sự ổn định hơn.

pa.cau: It has become much more common among younger workers. Older generations tended to stay with one employer, largely because job security was valued more highly.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt həz bɪˈkʌm mʌtʃ mɔː ˈkɑːmən‿əˈmʌŋ ˈjʌŋɡə ˈwɜːkəz ˈəʊldə ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃənz ˈtendɪd tə steɪ wɪð‿wʌn‿eˈmplɔɪə ˈlɑːdʒliː bɪˈkɔːz dʒɒb sɪˈkjʊrətiː wəz ˈvæljuːd mɔː ˈhaɪliː/

luot.en: Should companies allow people to work from home?
luot.vi: Công ty có nên cho nhân viên làm việc tại nhà không?

pa.cau: Should companies allow people to work from home?
pa.ipa_noi: /ʃəd ˈkʌmpəˌniːz‿əˈlaʊ ˈpiːpəl tə wɜːk frəm həʊm/

luot.en: Where the work allows it, yes. It saves commuting time, though it does make it harder for new staff to learn from colleagues.
luot.vi: Nếu tính chất công việc cho phép thì nên. Nó tiết kiệm thời gian đi lại, dù khiến nhân viên mới khó học hỏi từ đồng nghiệp hơn.

pa.cau: Where the work allows it, yes. It saves commuting time, though it does make it harder for new staff to learn from colleagues.
pa.ipa_noi: /weə ðə wɜːk‿əˈlaʊz‿ɪ‿tʃes‿ɪt seɪvz kəˈmjuːtɪŋ taɪm ðəʊ ɪt dəz meɪk‿ɪt ˈhɑːdə fə nuː stɑːf tə lɜːn frəm ˈkɑːliːɡz/

luot.en: How do you see your career in ten years?
luot.vi: Mười năm nữa bạn hình dung sự nghiệp mình thế nào?

pa.cau: How do you see your career in ten years?
pa.ipa_noi: /haʊ də jə siː jə kəˈrɪə ɪn ten‿jɪəz/

luot.en: I would like to be leading a small team. That said, I am wary of planning too rigidly, since the industry changes quickly.
luot.vi: Tôi muốn được dẫn dắt một nhóm nhỏ. Dù vậy, tôi ngại lập kế hoạch quá cứng nhắc, vì ngành này thay đổi rất nhanh.

pa.cau: I would like to be leading a small team. That said, I am wary of planning too rigidly, since the industry changes quickly.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ wəd laɪk tə biː ˈliːdɪŋ‿ə smɔːl tiːm ðət sed‿aɪ əm ˈweriː əv ˈplænɪŋ tuː ˈrɪdʒɪdliː sɪns ðə ˈɪndəstriː ˈtʃeɪndʒəz ˈkwɪkliː/

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại 2 — Kỹ năng mềm và tuyển dụng

luot.en: Which skills do employers value most?
luot.vi: Nhà tuyển dụng coi trọng kỹ năng nào nhất?

pa.cau: Which skills do employers value most?
pa.ipa_noi: /wɪtʃ skɪlz də eˈmplɔɪəz ˈvæljuː məʊst/

luot.en: Communication comes first in almost every survey. Technical ability can be taught relatively quickly, whereas the ability to explain ideas clearly takes years.
luot.vi: Kỹ năng giao tiếp đứng đầu trong hầu hết các khảo sát. Kỹ năng chuyên môn có thể dạy khá nhanh, trong khi khả năng trình bày ý tưởng rõ ràng phải mất nhiều năm.

pa.cau: Communication comes first in almost every survey. Technical ability can be taught relatively quickly, whereas the ability to explain ideas clearly takes years.
pa.ipa_noi: /kəˌmjuːnəˈkeɪʃən kʌmz fɜːst‿ɪn ˈɔːˌlməʊst ˈevəriː səˈveɪ ˈteknɪkəl‿əˈbɪləˌtiː kən biː tɔːt ˈrelətɪvliː ˈkwɪkliː weˈræz ðə əˈbɪləˌtiː tə ɪkˈspleɪn‿aɪˈdiːəz ˈklɪəliː teɪks‿jɪəz/

luot.en: Can such skills be taught at university?
luot.vi: Những kỹ năng đó có dạy được ở đại học không?

pa.cau: Can such skills be taught at university?
pa.ipa_noi: /kən sʌtʃ skɪlz biː tɔːt‿ət ˌjuːnəˈvɜːsətiː/

luot.en: To some extent, through group projects and presentations. However, they develop far faster in a real workplace where the consequences matter.
luot.vi: Ở mức độ nào đó, qua bài tập nhóm và thuyết trình. Tuy nhiên chúng phát triển nhanh hơn nhiều trong môi trường làm việc thật, nơi hậu quả là có thật.

pa.cau: To some extent, through group projects and presentations. However, they develop far faster in a real workplace where the consequences matter.
pa.ipa_noi: /tə səm‿ɪˈkstent θruː ɡruːp ˈprɑːdʒekts‿ən ˌprezəˈnteɪʃənz ˌhaʊˈevə ðeɪ dɪˈveləp fɑː ˈfæstə ɪn‿ə riːl ˈwɜːˌkpleɪs‿weə ðə ˈkɑːnsəˌkwensəz ˈmætə/

luot.en: Are interviews a reliable way to choose staff?
luot.vi: Phỏng vấn có phải cách chọn người đáng tin không?

pa.cau: Are interviews a reliable way to choose staff?
pa.ipa_noi: /ə ˈɪntəˌvjuːz‿ə rɪˈlaɪəbl‿weɪ tə tʃuːz stɑːf/

luot.en: Only partly. They favour confident speakers, which means capable but quiet candidates are sometimes overlooked.
luot.vi: Chỉ một phần. Phỏng vấn có lợi cho người nói tự tin, nghĩa là ứng viên giỏi nhưng ít nói đôi khi bị bỏ sót.

pa.cau: Only partly. They favour confident speakers, which means capable but quiet candidates are sometimes overlooked.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈəʊnliː ˈpɑːtliː ðeɪ ˈfeɪvə ˈkɒnfɪdənt ˈspiːkəz‿wɪtʃ miːnz ˈkeɪpəbəl bət ˈkwaɪət ˈkændədeɪts‿ə səˈmtaɪmz ˈəʊvəˌlʊkt/

luot.en: What would be a better method?
luot.vi: Cách nào tốt hơn?

pa.cau: What would be a better method?
pa.ipa_noi: /wʌt‿wəd biː ə ˈbetə ˈmeθəd/

luot.en: A short paid trial task, in my opinion. It shows how someone actually works rather than how well they describe themselves.
luot.vi: Theo tôi là một bài thử việc ngắn có trả phí. Nó cho thấy người ta làm việc ra sao thay vì mô tả bản thân giỏi đến đâu.

pa.cau: A short paid trial task, in my opinion. It shows how someone actually works rather than how well they describe themselves.
pa.ipa_noi: /ə ʃɔːt peɪd ˈtraɪəl tæsk‿ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən‿ɪt ʃəʊz haʊ ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈæˌktʃuːəliː wɜːks ˈræðə ðən haʊ wel ðeɪ dɪˈskraɪb ðeˈmselvz/

luot.en: Do you think artificial intelligence will change hiring?
luot.vi: Bạn nghĩ trí tuệ nhân tạo sẽ thay đổi việc tuyển dụng chứ?

luot.en: It already is, mainly in filtering applications. The risk is that it repeats the biases in the data it was trained on.
luot.vi: Nó đang thay đổi rồi, chủ yếu ở khâu lọc hồ sơ. Rủi ro là nó lặp lại chính những thiên lệch trong dữ liệu huấn luyện.

pa.cau: It already is, mainly in filtering applications. The risk is that it repeats the biases in the data it was trained on.

hoi_thoai.ten: Hội thoại - Cân bằng công việc

luot.en: Hi Lan, how is your new job?
luot.vi: Chào Lan, công việc mới của bạn thế nào?

pa.cau: Hi Lan, how is your new job?
pa.ipa_noi: /haɪ læn haʊ ɪz‿jə nuː dʒɒb/

luot.en: It is busy. My workload is very high.
luot.vi: Nó rất bận. Khối lượng công việc của mình rất cao.

pa.cau: It is busy. My workload is very high.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz ˈbɪzi maɪ ˈwɜːkləʊd‿ɪz ˈveriː haɪ/

luot.en: Do you have a good work-life balance now?
luot.vi: Hiện tại bạn có sự cân bằng giữa công việc và cuộc sống tốt không?

pa.cau: Do you have a good work-life balance now?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə həv‿ə ɡʊd‿wɜːk laɪf ˈbæləns naʊ/

luot.en: Not really. I feel burnout every day.
luot.vi: Không hẳn. Mình cảm thấy kiệt sức mỗi ngày.

pa.cau: Not really. I feel burnout every day.
pa.ipa_noi: /nɑːt ˈrɪliː aɪ fiːl ˈbɜːnaʊt ˈevəriː deɪ/

luot.en: Maybe you need remote work for some days.
luot.vi: Có lẽ bạn cần làm việc từ xa một vài ngày.

pa.cau: Maybe you need remote work for some days.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈmeɪbiː jə niːd rɪˈməʊt‿wɜːk fə səm deɪz/

luot.en: My boss does not like remote work much.
luot.vi: Sếp mình không thích làm việc từ xa lắm.

pa.cau: My boss does not like remote work much.
pa.ipa_noi: /maɪ bɑːs dəz nɑːt laɪk rɪˈməʊt‿wɜːk mʌtʃ/

luot.en: That is hard. What about your career path?
luot.vi: Thật khó khăn. Còn con đường sự nghiệp của bạn thì sao?

pa.cau: That is hard. What about your career path?
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət‿ɪz hɑːd‿wʌt‿əˈbaʊ‿tʃə kəˈrɪə pæθ/

luot.en: I want a promotion, but I am tired.
luot.vi: Mình muốn được thăng chức, nhưng mình đang mệt mỏi.

pa.cau: I want a promotion, but I am tired.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ wɑːnt‿ə prəˈməʊʃn bət‿aɪ əm ˈtaɪəd/

luot.en: You should talk to your manager soon.
luot.vi: Bạn nên nói chuyện với quản lý sớm nhé.

pa.cau: You should talk to your manager soon.
pa.ipa_noi: /jə ʃəd tɔːk tə jə ˈmænɪdʒə suːn/

luot.en: I plan to do that this Friday.
luot.vi: Mình dự định sẽ làm điều đó vào thứ Sáu này.

pa.cau: I plan to do that this Friday.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ plæn tə də ðət ðɪs ˈfraɪdiː/

luot.en: Good luck with your job satisfaction.
luot.vi: Chúc bạn hài lòng với công việc của mình.

pa.cau: Good luck with your job satisfaction.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɡʊd lʌk‿wɪð‿jə dʒɒb ˌsætəˈsfækʃən/

luot.en: Thanks, I hope things get better.
luot.vi: Cảm ơn, mình hy vọng mọi thứ sẽ tốt hơn.

pa.cau: Thanks, I hope things get better.
pa.ipa_noi: /θæŋks‿aɪ həʊp θɪŋz ɡet ˈbetə/

luot.en: Do you enjoy your office environment?
luot.vi: Bạn có thích môi trường văn phòng không?

pa.cau: Do you enjoy your office environment?
pa.ipa_noi: /də jə ɪnˈdʒɔɪ jə ˈɒfɪs‿ɪˈnvaɪrənmənt/

luot.en: It is okay, but the deadline pressure is high.
luot.vi: Nó cũng ổn, nhưng áp lực thời hạn rất lớn.

pa.cau: It is okay, but the deadline pressure is high.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz ˌəʊˈkeɪ bət ðə ˈdedlaɪn ˈpreʃə ɪz haɪ/

luot.en: Maybe you can find a freelance job.
luot.vi: Có lẽ bạn có thể tìm một công việc tự do.

pa.cau: Maybe you can find a freelance job.
pa.ipa_noi: /ˈmeɪbiː jə kən faɪnd‿ə ˈfriːlɑːns dʒɒb/

luot.en: That is an interesting idea for me.
luot.vi: Đó là một ý tưởng thú vị đối với mình.

pa.cau: That is an interesting idea for me.
pa.ipa_noi: /ðət‿ɪz‿ən ˈɪntrəstɪŋ‿aɪˈdiːə fə miː/

luot.en: Hi Nam, are you looking for employment?
luot.vi: Chào Nam, bạn đang tìm việc làm phải không?

pa.cau: Hi Nam, are you looking for employment?
pa.ipa_noi: /haɪ næm‿ə jə ˈlʊkɪŋ fə ɪmˈplɔɪmənt/

luot.en: Yes, the unemployment rate is high now.
luot.vi: Đúng vậy, tỷ lệ thất nghiệp hiện nay rất cao.

pa.cau: Yes, the unemployment rate is high now.
pa.ipa_noi: /jes ðə ˌʌnɪˈmplɔɪmənt reɪt‿ɪz haɪ naʊ/

luot.en: It is hard to join the workforce.
luot.vi: Thật khó để gia nhập lực lượng lao động.

pa.cau: It is hard to join the workforce.
pa.ipa_noi: /ɪt‿ɪz hɑːd tə dʒɔɪn ðə ˈwɜːkfɔːs/

luot.en: I send many emails every single day.
luot.vi: Mình gửi rất nhiều email mỗi ngày.

pa.cau: I send many emails every single day.
pa.ipa_noi: /aɪ send ˈmeniː iːˈmeɪlz ˈevəriː ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ/

luot.en: Do they offer any good incentives?

doan_van.ten: Đoạn văn mẫu — Xu hướng làm việc hiện đại
doan_van.noi_dung: In recent years, the structure of the global workforce has changed dramatically. The traditional career path of working for a single employer until retirement is no longer the norm. Today, many individuals choose remote work or freelance options to achieve a better work-life balance. These flexible arrangements allow employees to manage their own schedules, which often contributes to higher job satisfaction. Furthermore, modern companies frequently offer financial incentives to boost productivity among staff members, ensuring that top talent remains motivated and committed to corporate goals. However, flexible working conditions do not completely eliminate workplace stress. Many workers still experience severe deadline pressure, which can cause serious health issues and mental exhaustion. In fact, the main reason for burnout is that employees often face an excessive workload without adequate rest. This problem can also be caused by poor management, inadequate resources, and unclear expectations. When staff members suffer from extreme fatigue, their overall performance declines, which can eventually lead to financial losses for the business. Another significant factor affecting employment stability is rapid technological development. As automation becomes more common, some traditional roles become redundant. Consequently, workers are forced to learn new practical skills to remain competitive in the labour market. A high unemployment rate can result in widespread social challenges as well as reduced economic growth for the whole nation. Moreover, ambitious workers usually expect a promotion to advance their careers after achieving good results. If companies fail to recognise hard work, lower employee morale will result from this lack of appreciation. Ultimately, creating a supportive working environment has a positive impact on both worker well-being and corporate success.

- **employee** /ɪmˈplɔɪiː/ — trọng âm âm thứ 2 (Anh-Anh) hoặc cuối (Anh-Mỹ); **employer** /ɪmˈplɔɪə/.
- **productivity** /ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti/ — 5 âm tiết, nhấn **-TIV-**.
- **career** /kəˈrɪə/ — nhấn âm **sau**. Nhấn sai thành “CA-reer” là lỗi phổ biến.
luu_y:
**① lead to / result in + DANH TỪ, không phải mệnh đề.**
❌ Long hours lead to people get tired. → ✅ Long hours lead to **tiredness** / lead to **people getting** tired.

**② result IN (kết quả) vs result FROM (nguyên nhân) — ngược nhau hoàn toàn:**

- Stress **results from** overwork. (stress là kết quả)
- Overwork **results in** stress. (stress là kết quả)

**③ work không đếm được (nhắc lại):** ❌ many works → ✅ a lot of **work** / many **jobs**.

**④ Nhóm từ dễ nhầm:**

- **employee** (nhân viên) / **employer** (người sử dụng lao động) — chỉ khác 2 chữ cuối, nhầm là đảo ngược nghĩa.
- **salary** (lương tháng) / **wage** (lương theo giờ/tuần) / **income** (thu nhập nói chung)
- **job** (công việc cụ thể) / **career** (sự nghiệp cả đời) / **work** (việc nói chung)

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Công việc và sự nghiệp
mini_story.truyen: Remote work creates a profound shift in modern employment. Many professionals find that working from home significantly improves their work-life balance. This flexibility often results in higher productivity because staff members avoid long commutes and office distractions. However, the lack of clear boundaries can lead to burnout for some individuals. Nam starts his weekday early by organizing his freelance tasks to meet every deadline pressure. He prioritizes his output to ensure that his career path remains steady despite the absence of a traditional office environment. Initially, he struggles with the isolation of his home setup. By late afternoon, he discovers that virtual meetings with his team actually increase his job satisfaction. This social connection helps him overcome the sense of professional distance. He eventually transforms his workspace into a hub of focus and engagement. His daily efficiency improves as he masters the balance between personal time and professional responsibilities.

mini_story.ten: Mini-story - Thử thách nhỏ ngoài văn phòng
mini_story.truyen: Minh works in a high-pressure office where heavy workload leads to frequent burnout. The company struggles with a rising unemployment rate in the sector, so management ignores the need for better work-life balance. One Tuesday, Minh leaves the office to deliver an urgent parcel during a busy shift. He chooses a freelance courier service to save time despite the risk to his productivity. Traffic gridlock causes a delay, and the courier vanishes with the package. This loss results in a missed deadline for a critical client report. His manager feels angry about the lack of professional care. Minh eventually loses his promotion incentive because of this single error. His career path changes instantly from a steady climb to a period of uncertainty. Now, he regrets his decision to trust a stranger with such important company property.
